services.name: Botox
services.description: Anti-wrinkle injections for forehead lines, frown lines, and crow's feet.
services.downtime: Minimal. Mild redness may occur for a few hours.

services.name: Dermal Fillers
services.description: Lip fillers, cheek fillers, and nasolabial fold treatment using hyaluronic acid.
services.downtime: Mild swelling for 24-48 hours is normal.

services.name: Consultation
services.description: A free initial consultation to discuss your goals and recommend the best treatment.

booking.cancellation_policy: 24-hour notice required for cancellations or rescheduling.

escalation_rules: Customer has a complaint or expresses dissatisfaction
Customer asks a medical question (e.g., contraindications, allergies, medications)
Customer requests a price negotiation or discount
More than 2 questions cannot be answered from the SOP
Customer explicitly asks to speak to a human or manager

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book via WhatsApp or through our website. We recommend booking a free consultation first.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: We require at least 24 hours notice to cancel or reschedule an appointment.

faqs.question: Are consultations free?
faqs.answer: Yes, initial consultations are completely free of charge.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Saturday, 9am to 7pm. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.
